buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT OF INFRARED TORCH 1. Scope of Supply The bidder shall supply Infrared Torch(es) conforming to the technical specifications mentioned below. The item shall be new, unused, genuine and free from manufacturing defects. 2. Technical Specifications

The Infrared Torch shall conform to the following minimum technical specifications: Ser No Parameter Required Specification (a) Product Type Infrared Torch (b) Product Features Adjustable (c) Power Source Battery Powered (d) Light Source Type LED (e) White Light Brightness 500 Lumens (f) Maximum Light Output 500 Lumens (g) Battery Type Lithium-Ion (h) Number of Batteries Required One Lithium-Ion Battery (i) Battery Included No (j) Water Resistance Waterproof (k) Light Source Wattage 5 Watts (l) Mounting Type Handheld (m) Bulb Shape/Size B10 (n) Light Source Special Feature Adjustable Focus (o) Number of Light Sources One (p) Light Path Distance 165 Yards or approximately 150 metres Note: The offered product must support infrared illumination. White-light brightness of 500 lumens alone shall not be considered sufficient proof of infrared capability. 3. General Conditions (a) The supplied item shall be brand new, unused and of the latest available model. (b) The bidder shall upload the manufacturer's product catalogue, technical datasheet or brochure clearly i ndicating compliance with the prescribed specifications. (c) The offered product shall be capable of providing infrared illumination. The bidder shall clearly indicate the infrared wavelength and confirm compatibility with the intended application. (d) The product shall be supplied with all standard accessories required for its operation, wherever applica ble. (e) The battery shall be procured separately, as the specified product does not include a battery. The bidd er shall clearly indicate the compatible battery model and type. (f) The bidder shall ensure that the product supplied is exactly as per the specifications accepted in the bid . 4. Warranty The supplied item shall carry a minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of successful delivery again st manufacturing defects. Any defective item identified during the warranty period shall be repaired or repl aced by the supplier without additional cost to the purchaser, as applicable. 5. Delivery and Inspection (a) Delivery shall be completed within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM contract. (b) The item shall be inspected by the consignee on receipt to verify quantity, physical condition and conf ormity with the accepted technical specifications. (c) Any item found damaged, defective or not conforming to the accepted specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to the purchaser. 6. Documentation The supplier shall provide the following documents along with the supply:

(a) Manufacturer's product catalogue or technical datasheet. (b) Warranty certificate. (c) Tax invoice. (d) User manual, wherever applicable. 7. Payment Payment shall be processed through GeM as per the terms and conditions of the contract, subject to satisfactory receipt and acceptance of the supplied item. 8. General Compliance All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GT C), bid conditions and relevant government procurement rules. .
